source: docs/epic/EPIC-017-work-items-that-fit.md — § Scope In 1-7, § Decisions D1-D8, § Open questions, § Closed when 1-10
note: A real /task-decomposer --epic breakdown of EPIC-017, cut into thin slices (blockers first). deps are 1-based indexes into this list; ids are derived at write time from the target store, never stored here.

tasks.title: Write the work-item store schema
done: `docs/work/README.md` names the six status folders, the filename rule, every frontmatter field and the sections, and states that status lives only in the folder.
assumes: The provisional schema the existing task files already use is formalised, not redesigned.

tasks.title: Stand up the six status folders
done: `docs/work/{backlog,todo,in_progress,review,done,cancel}/` exist in git, and the first transition is a `git mv` that `git log --follow` shows as a pure rename.

tasks.title: Record status-folder, title-filename, membership-frontmatter as an ADR
done: An accepted ADR records D1 with the rejected alternatives (membership nested under status; kerjaan's space-bearing filenames) and is indexed.

tasks.title: Detect the queue layout (v1, v2, mixed) by existence only
done: Every queue-touching skill names the layout it found, and detection tests `TODO.md` for existence only, never its content.
assumes: The queue-touching set is derived by two selectors, not listed from memory.

tasks.title: Refuse a v1 or mixed tree by name, with retained fixtures
done: Retained v1 · v2 · mixed fixtures; each refusing skill refuses v1 and mixed by name and points to `/lean-doc-generator migrate`, writing nothing.

tasks.title: Record the 2.0 hard cut as an ADR
done: An accepted ADR records that 2.0.0 is v2-only, superseding the dual-layout ruling, with the upgrade sequence.

tasks.title: Stamp sprint and epic membership in frontmatter
done: A task's `sprint:` and `epic:` live only in its frontmatter, at most one each, and a sprint file lists its members by path rather than containing them.

tasks.title: Derive sprint progress from member files
done: `/prime` and the epic rollup count `## Done when` boxes across member files; no progress figure is stored.

tasks.title: Prove derived progress against a hand count
done: On a real sprint, the derived progress equals a hand count of its member boxes, both numbers recorded.

tasks.title: Promote a sprint by reference
done: `promote` moves chosen tasks `backlog/ → todo/` with `git mv` in their own commit, stamps `sprint:`, and writes a Plan that carries no DoD copy.
assumes: The Plan remains an explicitly approved snapshot, by reference.

tasks.title: Check the plan freeze by reference
done: A member's `## Done when` edited after `plan_commit` without a `scope-change` entry naming it is reported; retained must-FAIL fixtures per check.

tasks.title: Close a sprint by reference
done: `close` refuses while any member sits outside `done/` or `cancel/`, and never counts Plan boxes.

tasks.title: Make /task-decomposer write one file per task
done: An approved breakdown writes one `docs/work/backlog/TASK-NNN-slug.md` per task with a derived id; `authority:`, `origin:`, `state:` and the assumptions survive.

tasks.title: Make /triage groom task files
done: `/triage` edits `priority:` and `state:` in place, derives order from priority and `depends-on`, and never folds readiness into a folder.

tasks.title: Make /orchestrator read sprint members by reference
done: sprint-bulk reads members, dispatch briefs and the review comparand from member files, with no Plan-copy dependency.

tasks.title: Make /handoff and /flow read the store
done: On a v2 fixture, `/handoff` finds the active sprint and `/flow` routes from the store, with no `TODO.md` read.

tasks.title: Make merge-back transitions coordinator-owned
done: Only the merge-back coordinator moves a task file between folders, and a duplicate id across two worktrees is refused at merge.
assumes: **open:** does a transition commit as `git mv` (rename detection) or move + `add -A`?

tasks.title: Retarget the task-metadata guards onto task files
done: The checkers that read `origin:` and `authority:` from TODO.md read task files instead, each with retained must-FAIL fixtures.

tasks.title: Retarget the conformance engine and gate wiring
done: The conformance engine and every gate leg that parsed TODO.md read the store; the gate stays green, read from its own verdict line.

tasks.title: Retarget the DoD-delta and verify-reaches checks
done: Both checks compare against member `## Done when` sections instead of Plan copies, with a retained must-FAIL each.

tasks.title: Measure tokens over the always-loaded read set
done: A check reports the token count of the always-loaded read set, naming the tokenizer, beside the line count.
assumes: Line counts stay as a secondary signal.

tasks.title: Guard against long prose lines
done: A ratchet fails when a capped file's count of dense prose lines grows; table rows are measured by cell.

tasks.title: Require a disposition for every promoted rule
done: An ADR superseding ADR-015 · ADR-017 · ADR-019 requires one of replace · merge · move · automate · retain-with-justification for each promoted rule.

tasks.title: Dispose of every standing OVER-CAP row
done: The gate reports zero OVER-CAP rows, each closed by a recorded disposition rather than a diet.
assumes: **open:** what disposes of the 3,050-line pre-epic hardening research file (23x its cap)?

tasks.title: Demote one rule through the disposition route
done: At least one rule leaves the always-loaded file with its destination recorded, and the file is inside its token budget.

tasks.title: Migrate a v1 repo onto the store
done: `/lean-doc-generator migrate` carries a v1 backlog into task files, re-runnable, reporting deltas and never clobbering an existing file.
assumes: `migrate` is the home, not a new command.

tasks.title: Prove both layout directions are safe
done: v2 skills against a v1 tree and v1 skills against a v2 tree are each exercised, each working or refusing cleanly, never corrupting.
assumes: The auto-update-off consumer is the normal case.

tasks.title: Migrate this repo and delete TODO.md
done: This repo's backlog is migrated and `TODO.md` deleted; the full gate is green afterwards, read from its own verdict line.

tasks.title: Derive zero executable readers of TODO.md
done: Two independent selectors find zero non-test readers of TODO.md across scripts/, evals/ and skills/, except the migrate procedure and bare existence checks.

tasks.title: Ship the store in templates and init
done: `/lean-doc-generator init` scaffolds `docs/work/` with its schema, so an installing consumer gets the store, not only this repo.

tasks.title: Migrate workdoo on a branch with its gate green
done: workdoo is migrated on a retained branch and its own gate stays green afterwards.
assumes: workdoo's 389-line TODO.md and 8 closed sprints are the real input.

tasks.title: Make the Work & Queue view read the store
done: The EPIC-016 Work & Queue view reads task status from the store folders, with no second copy of status.
assumes: **blocked-by:** workdoo adopting the store on its main branch.

tasks.title: Freeze the effectiveness baseline
done: Decomposition completeness, retrieval success and recurring-failure rate are measured before any change, with the method recorded.
assumes: Fewer lines and fewer checkboxes are not the success criterion.

tasks.title: Take the after effectiveness measurement
done: The baseline method is re-run unchanged on the finished plugin; the comparison and its verdict are recorded either way.

tasks.title: Amend the standard for the store
done: `spec/STANDARD.md` describes the store in place of the TODO.md Backlog wherever a task is filed or read.

tasks.title: Update the loop docs for the store
done: README and CONTEXT describe the loop against the store, with no TODO.md step left.

tasks.title: Release 2.0.0
done: All four manifests and the README footer read 2.0.0, the manifest set derived with `grep -l '"version"' .*-plugin/*.json`.
